title: urGameForge project manifest (contract version 1, TD-106, approved in principle 2026-11-25)
description: project-manifest.json at the project root. Defined by TD-106 (approved in principle 2026-11-25); implemented in editor-core project.contract and engine-babylon src/project/contract.ts (A12). Every existing file format (scene JSON, .terrain, .material, .sprite, .anim, .graph, glTF) is unchanged; this file adds identity, assets, capabilities and revision.

contractVersion.description: A reader refuses a higher number, naming it.

assets.description: Files a scene reaches, directly or through materials, sprites, prefabs and glTF buffers. Proposed limit: 20000 entries (confirmed at A12 from measured projects).

size.description: Bytes. Proposed per-file limit 536870912 (512 MiB), confirmed at A12.

licence.description: Id of the record in licenses/manifest.json (TD-094) for third-party files; absent for project-owned files.

required.description: A client missing one opens the project read-only, with the reason.

optional.description: A client missing one opens the project editable, naming the limits.

base.description: The revision this one was saved from; null for the first. A cloud store refuses a stale base (409).

extensions.description: Namespaced data (key 'vendor.area'); every client keeps entries it does not understand unchanged.

path.description: Relative to the project root, forward slashes; no '..', no leading '/', no drive letter, no backslash.

capability.description: <area>/<version>, or <area>:<qualifier>/<variant>; e.g. scene/1, terrain-edit/1, profile:action-rpg/3d, profile:platformer/2.5d.
